_doc: Counts by eye on whole validation sheets, from clean renders, not from the signature rule. index is the 0-based page. A sink is one basin unit (a double-bowl kitchen sink is 1). Mop sinks and drinking fountains are not sinks. A window is one opening in an exterior wall; panes with only a mullion between them are one window. approx: the count of that class has an error of about 15 %.
